trigger_condition: Popup closed or created successfully, then reopened without unmount
guard_snippet: const { reset } = useForm(...); useEffect(() => { if (!isOpen) reset(defaultValues) }, [isOpen])
potential_consequence: Stale email/username/password/role values from prior attempt resurface on reopen

trigger_condition: Maintainer switch is on, admin toggled off directly
potential_consequence: Sends is_maintainer:true with is_admin:false, an invalid role combination the edit flow forbids

trigger_condition: Admin or Maintainer already on, Auditor switch then toggled on
guard_snippet: disabled={isAdmin || isMaintainer} on the Auditor Switch, as in UserDetailsPopup.tsx
potential_consequence: Creates a user with is_auditor true alongside is_admin/is_maintainer true, an invalid combination the edit flow prevents

trigger_condition: Create button double-clicked or Enter repeated while createUser request in flight
potential_consequence: Duplicate POST /v1/admin/users requests fire before the first resolves, as guarded in sibling ResetBudgetPopup.tsx
